content:
If your glasses are loose, crooked, uncomfortable, scratched, or not sitting the way they should, bring them to Optometric Cafe on South Beverly Drive. We help with eyeglass adjustments, sunglass repairs, lens replacement questions, frame fitting, and practical repair guidance for prescription glasses and designer sunglasses.

Many customers visit us because they need quick, careful help from someone who understands how eyewear should fit. Morteza is especially known for expert fittings, honest advice, and careful hands-on adjustments.

Need help today? Call (310) 888-2848 or get directions to our Beverly Hills boutique.

What We Can Help With

  • Loose or crooked eyeglass frames
  • Sunglasses that need tightening or adjustment
  • Nose pad comfort and fit issues
  • Frames that slide, pinch, or sit unevenly
  • Questions about replacement lenses for suitable existing frames, including prescription glasses or sunglasses
  • Evaluation of scratched sunglass lenses
  • High-prescription frame fitting and fit checks for progressives and designer frames

Honest Repair Advice

Not every scratched lens can be buffed safely. Sometimes polishing a lens can distort the optics or damage coatings. We will inspect the glasses and explain the practical options clearly, whether that means a quick adjustment, replacement lenses, or a different solution.

Because Optometric Cafe has an in-house optical workshop, we can evaluate eyewear with more context than a shop that sends every detail away.

Designer Sunglasses and Prescription Frames

We regularly help customers with premium eyewear, designer sunglasses, prescription frames, and specialty lenses. If you have a favorite pair, bring it in. We can check whether it can be adjusted, repaired, or updated with new lenses.

For related guidance, read our articles on how to care for your glasses properly, cheap sunglasses and eye protection, and prescription sunglasses before summer.

What Customers Say

“In and out very quickly and efficiently! Took 5 minutes to fix my sunglasses.”

– Matt, Google review

“The absolute best customer service he fixed my client Dior glasses in 30 mins and explained all he did and made it better than it was very professional and amazing prices thank you.”

– kika guirguis, Google review

“It’s always a pleasure to stop by this place in the heart of Beverly Hills and have Morteza help me with all of my optometry needs. To my delight he went above and beyond for a repair need that I had.”

– Joel Villalpando, Google review

Visit Optometric Cafe

Optometric Cafe is located at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. If your glasses need attention, stop by or call ahead at (310) 888-2848.

content:
Morteza’s In-House Optical Workshop

Morteza personally oversees lens craftsmanship and frame fitting in our Beverly Hills optical workshop. We customize prescription eyeglasses and sunglasses with attention to the frame, lens design, measurements, and final fit. For complicated prescriptions, read about high-prescription glasses and frame fit.

A favorite pair of quality frames may be worth keeping. Morteza inspects the frame’s condition, construction, and suitability before recommending new lenses for suitable existing frames. We can also advise on adjustments and repairs for vintage designer frames or everyday glasses.

Our in-house optical lab in Beverly Hills fabricates and fits lenses with exacting tolerances—ideal for complex prescriptions, sunglass tints/polarization, and careful frame adjustments.

Optometric Cafe Lens Design and Treatment Technology Include

Lens Types

  • Single Vision Lenses – Clear vision at one distance, ideal for reading or distance.

  • No-Line Progressives – Lens design and measurements work together for near, intermediate, and distance vision. Learn about progressive glasses and precise fitting.

  • Bifocals, Trifocals, and Multifocal Lenses – Distinct segments for multiple focal points.

  • High-Index, Thinner Lenses – Lightweight option for stronger prescriptions.

  • Computer & Transition Lenses – Reduced eye strain for screen use, lenses that adapt to light.

Lens Treatments

  • Scratch-Resistant Coatings – Protect lenses from everyday wear.

  • Anti-Glare & Anti-Reflective Coatings – Improve clarity and comfort, especially at night.

  • Polarized & Tinted Lenses – Reduce glare and enhance contrast in bright conditions.

  • UV Protection – Block harmful UV rays for long-term eye health.

  • UV Sunglasses – Fashion and protection combined, available in prescription or non-prescription.

Services in Our In-House Lab

  • Custom lens crafting and precision fitting.

  • Complex prescription handling for all frame styles.

  • Lens replacement and upgrades.

  • Frame adjustments and repairs.

Related Optical Lab Guides

To plan your eyewear, read our guides to choosing prescription glasses, designer eyewear fit, and computer glasses for digital eye strain.

See how the lab supports luxury designer frames, prescription sunglasses, and the Beverly Hills eyewear boutique experience.

Explore our handpicked selection of designer frames and let Morteza guide you
to eyewear you’ll truly love.

openGraph.og:title: About Morteza and Our Optical Boutique | Optometric Cafe
openGraph.og:description: Meet Morteza Talebi at Optometric Cafe, a family-owned Beverly Hills optical boutique for personal eyewear fittings and in-house lens craftsmanship.
openGraph.twitter:title: About Morteza and Our Optical Boutique | Optometric Cafe
openGraph.twitter:description: Meet Morteza Talebi at Optometric Cafe, a family-owned Beverly Hills optical boutique for personal eyewear fittings and in-house lens craftsmanship.

content:
Since 2005, Optometric Cafe has been owned and operated by Morteza Talebi and his family in Beverly Hills. Morteza brings decades of hands-on experience to eyewear fitting, lens craftsmanship, and adjustments. Get to know Morteza and our in-house optical workshop, where we work on complex prescriptions and evaluate favorite frames for new lenses. Our boutique also offers designer eyewear and sunglasses for men, women, and children.

As a family-owned optical boutique, we believe in building lasting relationships with our patients. Morteza and our optical team guide you through the latest advancements in lens technology, frame design, and vision care. Our eyewear selection features world-class designers including Persol, Salt, Oliver Peoples, Chanel, Prada, Paul Smith, Tom Ford, Lunor, SwissFlex, Anglo American, Maui Jim, Ray-Ban, Liberty Sport, Alain Mikli, Kawasaki Kids, 2.5 Eyewear Kids, Victory Collection, Prodesign Denmark, Mykita, Eye-bobs, Velocity, Ray-Ban Jr. and select vintage frames. Each pair—glasses or sunglasses—is chosen for style, durability, and superior optical performance.

Our Story & Philosophy

Optometric Cafe was founded with a simple mission: combine personal eyewear fitting and optical craftsmanship with a welcoming, boutique shopping experience. For nearly two decades, Morteza Talebi has personally fitted thousands of patients, bringing unmatched craftsmanship and attention to detail. Unlike chain optical stores, every adjustment, lens choice, and style recommendation comes from an experienced professional who knows your unique needs. Our goal is simple—to help you see better and look your best.

Our Sunglasses Expertise

We’re a leading destination for luxury sunglasses in Beverly Hills. From timeless aviators to bold, fashion-forward frames, our selection includes both prescription and non-prescription sunglasses from designers like Maui Jim, Oliver Peoples, Ray-Ban, Mykita, and Tom Ford. We specialize in polarized lenses for superior glare reduction and high-performance options for active lifestyles. Whether you’re strolling down Rodeo Drive or spending the weekend outdoors, we’ll help you find sunglasses that protect your eyes and reflect your personal style.

Personal Fittings and Lens Craftsmanship

Our services go beyond selecting a new frame. Morteza guides lens choices, measurements, repairs, and final adjustments, with particular care for difficult prescriptions and glasses that are hard to fit. Our in-house workshop also evaluates suitable existing frames for replacement lenses. Explore prescription glasses, progressive glasses fitting, and our sunglasses collection. If you need an eye exam, please call to confirm optometrist availability.

Personal Service from a Family-Owned Optical Shop

At Optometric Cafe, you’re never just another appointment. Morteza and our team take the time to understand your lifestyle and vision goals. Being family-owned means we offer flexible, personalized service—whether that’s rushing an order for a special event or sourcing a rare designer frame just for you. Many of our patients have been with us for years, bringing their children and even grandchildren for care. Read more about our commitment to quality.

Visit Us on South Beverly Drive

Located just minutes from Rodeo Drive, our boutique is easy to reach from Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and Century City. Visit to compare frames, discuss an existing prescription, or have Morteza assess your current glasses. Contact us to arrange a personal fitting. Please call ahead to confirm availability if you need an eye exam.

Find Your Perfect Glasses Today

Whether you’re looking for prescription eyeglasses, stylish sunglasses, or a custom fit for your unique face shape, Optometric Cafe is here to help. Explore our handpicked selection of designer frames and let Morteza guide you to eyewear you’ll truly love.

Book Your Appointment

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby. We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, The Flats, Holmby Hills, Bel-Air, Benedict Canyon, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Cheviot Hills, South Carthay, and Monte Mar Vista. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.

openGraph.twitter:title: Children’s Sunglasses Beverly Hills | Optometric Cafe
openGraph.twitter:description: Find children’s sunglasses in Beverly Hills, including prescription kids sunglasses, comfortable fittings, durable frames, and UV protection.

content:
Kids love to look like Mom, Dad, and older siblings — and we love helping them do it safely. At Optometric Cafe, our children’s sunglasses include prescription options with impact-resistant lenses and 100% UV protection, fitted by our family optician, Morteza.

From cool, “just-like-the-grownups” shapes to colorful, sporty frames, we carry styles kids actually want to wear —and wear consistently. Visit our Beverly Hills boutique to explore options and get a comfortable, secure fit.

FASHIONABLE AND SHOCK RESISTANT SUNGLASSES TOO

We’ve curated a cheerful, durable collection of kids’ sunglasses so families can find styles that feel fun for children and reassuring for parents. Think oval, round, rectangular, cat-eye, and geometric silhouettes in easy-to-match colors like green, blue, tortoise, and black — plus sporty wraparounds that mirror trendy adult looks. When needed, we craft prescription sunglasses in-house for crisp, comfortable vision outdoors.

Why Children’s Sunglasses Matter (Without the Lecture)

Kids spend more time outside than most adults — playgrounds, sports, beach days, and school outings — so a reliable pair of UV-blocking sunglasses quickly becomes part of everyday life. Because young eyes filter light differently, we take extra care with lens materials and coatings to protect against UV and high-energy visible (HEV) light while keeping things lightweight and comfy.

Our goal is simple: make sunglasses kids want to wear, with the protection parents expect.

Comfortable Fits Kids Will Actually Wear

Frames they’ll love

  • “Mini-me” adult-style frames (always a hit for tweens).
  • Bright, modern plastics in rich colors and soft-touch finishes.
  • Sporty wraparounds for playgrounds and weekend games.
  • Flexible temples and adjustable bridges for growing faces.

Protection you’ll trust

  • 100% UVA/UVB protection across our children’s range.

content:
Men’s sunglasses are more than accessories — they’re everyday essentials that combine protection and confidence. At Optometric Cafe, we’ve curated a collection of high-quality, stylish frames in our Beverly Hills boutique, each designed with durable construction and 100% UVA/UVB protection.

Whether you prefer timeless aviators, bold square frames, or minimalist modern styles, our selection helps you find sunglasses that fit your face, your lifestyle, and your personal style. With personalized guidance, you’ll leave with a pair that feels made for you.

Choosing the right pair of sunglasses involves more than picking a fashionable frame. At Optometric Cafe, we help you balance style, comfort, and protection. Every frame is carefully selected for durability, lens quality, and fit — and many of our styles can be made into prescription sunglasses in our optometry lab.

Our goal is to make finding sunglasses simple, enjoyable, and tailored to you. Instead of browsing endless rows of frames online, you’ll have the chance to try on curated options in person, with guidance from an expert who makes sure they sit comfortably and complement your look.

Protect Your Eyes with Confidence

Sun protection is non-negotiable. Men often spend significant time outdoors — driving, sports, beach days, or simply walking through Los Angeles sunshine. High-quality sunglasses should do three things:

  • Block 100% UVA and UVB rays to protect your eyes and skin.
  • Reduce glare with optional polarized lenses for comfort while driving or outdoors.
  • Provide impact-resistant strength for active lifestyles.

At Optometric Cafe, every men’s style we carry meets these standards, giving you peace of mind along with timeless design.

Not sure where you fit? That’s where our personal fitting process makes the difference. We’ll have you try different silhouettes until you find the style that feels right — and looks even better.

Prescription Sunglasses for Men

If you already wear glasses, prescription sunglasses simplify outdoor life. Whether you need single-vision lenses or progressives, we’ll customize lenses to match your prescription exactly. Options include:

  • Polarized prescription lenses to cut glare while driving.
  • Scratch-resistant coatings for everyday use.
  • Gradient tints for a stylish finish with functional comfort.
  • Custom clip-ons available for select prescription glasses.

All lenses are crafted in our in-house lab for precision and faster turnaround.

Timeless & Modern Men’s Styles

Our men’s sunglasses collection balances classic design with modern updates. You’ll find:

  • Aviators – Always versatile and masculine.
  • Wayfarer-inspired frames – Iconic, sharp, and easy to wear daily.
  • Round lenses – Minimalist and relaxed, great for square or angular features.
  • Sport frames – Secure wraparounds for outdoor activity or recreation.

No matter your preference, every pair is authentic, high-quality, and fitted to you personally in our boutique.

Need to update your prescription first? Book an eye exam at Optometric Cafe, then explore men’s sunglasses, contact lenses, and more in one convenient visit.

Serving South Beverly Hills & Nearby Neighborhoods

Located in South Beverly Hills, our boutique is just minutes from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Whether you’re visiting after work or stopping by on the weekend, we’re proud to be the local choice for personal, high-quality eyewear.

Visit us at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. Call (310) 888-2848 to schedule your fitting.

FAQs: Men’s Sunglasses

Do you carry prescription men’s sunglasses?
Yes. Most of our men’s designer frames can be customized with prescription lenses in our in-house lab.
Which sunglasses styles work best for men?
Aviators, square frames, and Wayfarer-inspired shapes are timeless favorites, while round and sport frames add variety.
Do you offer polarized lenses?
Yes. Polarized prescription and non-prescription options are available to reduce glare.
How do I know which sunglasses fit my face shape?
We’ll guide you through styles that balance and flatter your features during your fitting appointment.
Do you carry sport sunglasses?
Yes, we stock wraparound sport frames for active men who need comfort and durability outdoors.

Related Sunglasses Guides

Learn more about prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses, sports glasses and prescription sunglasses, and designer eyewear fit.

Discover men’s designer sunglasses that balance performance and style. From classic aviators to modern prescription frames, we’ll help you find sunglasses that fit your face and your lifestyle. Visit our Beverly Hills boutique or call (310) 888-2848 to get started.

Book Men’s Sunglasses Fitting

Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.

content:
Contact Lenses in Beverly Hills

Finding the right contact lenses isn’t just about convenience — it’s about comfort, safety, and professional care. At Optometric Cafe, we make the process easy and reliable. Our optician, Morteza, helps you choose and fit the best lenses for your prescription and lifestyle, while our in-office ophthalmologist is available for comprehensive eye exams and prescription updates.

Once your prescription is verified, we order directly from trusted manufacturers such as Acuvue, Ciba Vision, and Bausch + Lomb, and have your lenses ready for pickup in our Beverly Hills boutique.

Why Choose Professional Contact Lens Care?

Ordering contact lenses online can seem simple, but without proper fitting and guidance, you risk dryness, irritation, or long-term eye damage. At Optometric Cafe, we combine medical oversight with boutique service to give you the best of both worlds:

  • Professional fitting: Morteza ensures every lens suits your eye shape, prescription, and wear schedule.
  • Medical oversight: Our ophthalmologist provides exams and prescription updates as needed.
  • Personal guidance: Learn proper care, insertion, and cleaning techniques.
  • Trusted brands: Acuvue, Ciba Vision, Bausch + Lomb.
  • Convenience: Order through us and pick up locally — no shipping hassles.

Contact Lens Brands We Carry

Acuvue Contact Lenses

Acuvue is one of the most popular brands worldwide, known for comfort and innovation. Patients love Acuvue’s daily disposables, toric lenses for astigmatism, and multifocal lenses. Whether you need convenience or advanced correction, Acuvue has a solution.

Ciba Vision Contact Lenses

Ciba Vision offers a range of contact lenses designed for clarity, comfort, and unique needs. Their specialty designs and cosmetic color lenses are a favorite for patients who want both function and style.

Bausch + Lomb Contact Lenses

With over a century of optical innovation, Bausch + Lomb remains a leader in vision care. Their lenses are known for sharp vision, advanced materials, and durability. From daily wear to specialty lenses, they provide reliable solutions for patients of all ages.

Types of Contact Lenses We Offer

Every patient’s eyes are unique, which is why we offer a full spectrum of lens options:

  • Daily, weekly, and monthly disposables
  • Multifocal and bifocal contact lenses for presbyopia
  • Toric lenses for astigmatism
  • Rigid gas permeable and specialty lenses
  • Tinted and cosmetic lenses for appearance enhancement
  • Custom designs for complex prescriptions

Thinking about upgrading to contacts? Start with our guide to contact lens fittings in Beverly Hills, compare daily vs monthly contact lenses, then schedule your exam.

The Contact Lens Ordering Process

We make ordering your lenses simple and stress-free:

  1. Eye exam (if needed): Our ophthalmologist provides comprehensive exams and verifies your prescription.
  2. Professional fitting: Morteza measures and fits your lenses for comfort and performance.
  3. Custom ordering: We place your order directly with Acuvue, Ciba Vision, or Bausch + Lomb.
  4. Boutique pickup: Your lenses are delivered to our Beverly Hills boutique — ready for you to collect at your convenience.

Caring for Your Contact Lenses

Proper care keeps your vision clear and your eyes healthy. At Optometric Cafe, we guide you through:

  • Safe insertion and removal techniques
  • Choosing the right cleaning solutions for your lenses
  • When and how often to replace lenses
  • Avoiding common issues such as irritation or buildup

For new wearers, we provide in-office training sessions to ensure you feel comfortable from the very first day.

Who Benefits from Our Contact Lens Services?

  • New wearers: Learn how to safely transition from glasses to contacts.
  • Busy professionals: Daily disposables and extended-wear options for convenience.
  • Specialty patients: Astigmatism, presbyopia, or complex prescriptions.
  • Style seekers: Colored or cosmetic lenses for appearance and fashion.
  • Local residents & visitors: Serving Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Century City, and greater Los Angeles.

Why Patients Trust Optometric Cafe

  • Boutique care: Personal service from a family-owned Beverly Hills practice.
  • Experience: Morteza’s fitting expertise helps ensure the right lens and the right wear schedule.
  • Medical oversight: In-office ophthalmologist available for exams and ongoing care.
  • Trusted brands: Only lenses from globally recognized manufacturers.
  • Convenience & trust: Skip the online guesswork — rely on your local eye care team.

Ready to order your lenses? Call us at (310) 888-2848 or visit Optometric Cafe today.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Do I need a prescription for contact lenses?

Yes. Contact lenses are medical devices, and a valid prescription is required. Our in-office ophthalmologist provides comprehensive eye exams if yours needs updating.

How long does it take to receive my lenses?

Most orders arrive within a few business days, and we’ll notify you when they are ready for boutique pickup.

Can you order colored or specialty contact lenses?

Absolutely. We carry tinted and cosmetic lenses, as well as specialty designs for astigmatism or other unique prescriptions.

Do you offer training for first-time contact lens wearers?

Yes. Morteza provides personalized training to ensure you know how to insert, remove, and care for your lenses properly.

Which areas do you serve?

We are located in Beverly Hills and serve patients from surrounding areas, including West Hollywood, Century City, and Los Angeles.

Book Your Contact Lens Fitting in Beverly Hills

Get contacts that feel great and match your lifestyle — with professional fitting and medical oversight. Learn more about what happens during a contact lens fitting or call (310) 888-2848 or book online to get started.

Book Contact Lens Fitting

Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.

content:
Hours on screens shouldn’t leave your eyes tired. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we make computer and gaming glasses that feel great to wear and help you stay comfortable—whether you’re working, studying, editing, streaming, or gaming late with friends.

We offer well-known options like GUNNAR along with custom computer lenses crafted in our on-site laboratory. Morteza handpicks frames for comfort under headsets and long desk days, then we fine-tune lenses for your screen setup and distance. Friendly guidance, precise fits, never pushy.

Why Choose Computer or Gaming Glasses?

Modern work and play happen on screens. Computer and gaming glasses are designed to support the way you actually use your eyes—extended viewing at one to three feet, shifting focus between monitors, chats, and notes, and staying comfortable under bright indoor lighting. The right lenses can ease digital eye strain, reduce glare, sharpen contrast, and help you maintain better posture by letting your eyes relax at your true working distance.

Two Great Paths: GUNNAR or Custom Lab Lenses

We carry GUNNAR computer eyewear for customers who prefer a brand with purpose-built designs and contrast-enhancing tints. We also build custom computer lenses in your favorite frame—single-vision for a fixed distance, or office/desk progressives that give you a generous intermediate zone for multiple screens plus a comfortable near area for documents. Not sure what you need? We’ll try lens samples and dial in the working distance that matches your setup.

Lens Features That Make a Difference

  • Anti-reflective coatings: Cut harsh glare from overheads and screens so text looks crisp and eyes feel calmer on video calls.
  • Blue-light comfort options: Select from clear AR coatings that reduce screen glare or light-amber tints that gently boost contrast. We’ll match the choice to your job, color-accuracy needs, and environment.
  • Office/desk progressives: For multi-monitor or laptop-plus-doc workflows, these lenses maximize the intermediate zone so you’re not craning forward to see clearly.
  • Prescription accuracy: From plano to complex prescriptions, we center and calibrate lenses for your exact viewing distance so your eyes can relax naturally.
  • Optional wrap & coverage: Certain designs reduce airflow around the eyes, which can help with dryness in AC or heated rooms.

GUNNAR at Optometric Cafe

Many customers appreciate GUNNAR’s purpose-built designs for extended screen time. Select models feature wrapped profiles, tints that enhance contrast, and lens geometries aimed at easier focusing at computer distance. If you’re curious, we’ll have you try GUNNAR side-by-side with our custom lens options so you can feel the difference and pick what’s most comfortable for your eyes and your workflow.

Custom Lenses From Our On-Site Lab

Because we craft lenses in our Beverly Hills lab, you get faster turnaround and tighter quality control than mail-out shops. We regularly handle high prescriptions, astigmatism, and fine alignment work for office and gaming use. Want to duplicate your exact chair-to-monitor distance? Bring a quick measurement or photo of your setup and we’ll optimize the focal point so your posture stays natural and your eyes relax.

Frames Handpicked by Morteza

Comfort is everything for long sessions. Morteza curates frames that are light, stable, and headset-friendly—think slimmer temples that sit neatly under headphones, silicone nose pads that stay put, and materials that hold adjustment. Whether you prefer understated minimalism or a bolder statement, you’ll find not-run-of-the-mill styles that look sharp on camera and feel good all day.

For Gamers: Comfort, Focus, Endurance

Gaming puts unique demands on your eyes and posture. We’ll tune lenses for your primary screen distance and preferred seating, consider a light contrast tint if you like, and make sure your frame plays nicely with your headset. If you’re sensitive to room airflow or AC, we can explore slightly more wrapped designs to help keep eyes comfortable during long sessions.

For Work & Study: Clarity and Posture

Office and study setups are rarely one-size-fits-all. If you switch between a laptop, a second display, and print materials, office/desk progressives can reduce the urge to hunch toward the screen. Prefer a single-vision computer pair? We’ll set the focal length for your exact desk distance so your neck and shoulders can relax while you keep text crisp across your primary monitor.

Dry-Eye & Bright-Light Considerations

Staring at screens reduces blink rate, and HVAC can make dryness worse. Lenses with excellent AR coatings, frames with stable fit, and modest wrap or side coverage can all help. We’ll walk you through practical comfort choices—from lens finish to frame geometry—so your eyes feel better at the end of the day.

Prescription, Turnaround & Insurance

We build both non-prescription and prescription computer lenses. Because production happens in our lab, most standard jobs are ready quickly; complex designs may take a bit longer. We’ll outline timing at your fitting. If you’re using vision benefits, bring your details and we’ll help you understand eligible options.

Local & Family-Owned

Optometric Cafe is a family-owned boutique on South Beverly Drive, serving Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. We keep your measurements and preferences on file, adjust frames anytime, and help you evolve your computer eyewear as your setup or role changes.

FAQs: Computer & Gaming Glasses

Do I need blue-light filtering?
Many people find comfort benefits from glare reduction and select blue-light options, especially under bright LEDs or at night. We’ll recommend a clear AR or light-amber approach based on your color-accuracy needs and environment.
Are GUNNAR lenses available with my prescription?
We can review current availability and, if needed, craft custom prescription computer lenses in your preferred frame with similar comfort goals.
What’s the difference between office/desk progressives and regular progressives?
Office/desk designs expand the intermediate zone used for screens and reduce the far-distance area. They’re great if most of your day is at arm’s length with occasional near work.
How long will my glasses take?
Because we fabricate lenses in our on-site lab, standard jobs are ready quickly; specialized designs may take longer. We’ll give you a clear timeline at your fitting.
Will these help with headaches and eye strain?
By aligning lenses to your true working distance and reducing reflections and glare, many people experience less strain. We’ll tailor the solution to your setup for the best comfort.

Exploring eyewear for every part of your week? Visit our pages for prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, and sports glasses. If you wear contacts, see contact lenses for screen-friendly fits.

Related Screen Comfort Guides

Read our guides to computer glasses for digital eye strain, how often to get an eye exam, and contact lens comfort and fitting.

Book Your Computer & Gaming Glasses Fitting

Feel the difference of lenses tuned to your screen distance and workflow. Try GUNNAR and our custom lab lenses side-by-side at Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills. Call (310) 888-2848 or book online to get started.

Book Computer Glasses Fitting

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby. We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, The Flats, Holmby Hills, Bel-Air, Benedict Canyon, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Cheviot Hills, South Carthay, and Monte Mar Vista. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.

content:
Sports demand more from your eyewear than everyday glasses. At Optometric Cafe, we provide sports glasses and prescription sports sunglasses designed for protection, comfort, and performance on the field, the court, the slopes, or the water.

With impact-resistant lenses, wraparound frames, and full UV protection, our sports eyewear collection keeps your vision clear and your eyes safe. From baseball and basketball to skiing, surfing, and cycling — we’ll help you find gear that fits your sport and your lifestyle.

EYE GLASSES, GOGGLES AND EYE PROTECTION FOR SPORTS / SPORT SUNGLASSES GIVE YOU AN EDGE

It’s no secret that outdoor and athletic activity is more popular than ever. That makes properly fitted sports eyewear essential. Everyday glasses are not designed to handle impact, movement, or intense sunlight — in fact, ordinary frames may break and cause injury during sports. Sports glasses, on the other hand, are built for safety, clarity, and stability.

At Optometric Cafe, we fit athletes of all ages with prescription sports glasses, sports sunglasses, and specialty goggles, ensuring both performance and protection. Whether you’re a weekend golfer, a youth soccer player, or a skier tackling fresh powder, we’ll guide you toward the right fit.

Why Sports Glasses Matter

More than 100,000 sports-related eye injuries occur each year in the U.S., many of them preventable with the right eyewear. Sports glasses are designed with:

  • Impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses that protect against shattering.
  • Wraparound frames that stay secure during fast movement and protect against side impact.
  • 100% UVA/UVB protection for outdoor sports, reducing long-term eye damage risk.
  • Adjustable straps and cushions for comfort and a stay-put fit during activity.

Sports Glasses vs. Regular Eyewear

Glasses made for everyday use simply don’t cut it on the playing field. Frames not built for impact may crack under pressure, and standard lenses may shatter — posing more danger than protection. Sports glasses are purpose-built to protect your eyes, enhance vision, and withstand movement and sweat.

That’s why we recommend every athlete — child or adult — begin with an eye exam. Precise prescriptions and health screenings ensure your sports glasses not only protect, but also give you the clearest possible vision advantage in your game.

Prescription Sports Glasses & Sunglasses

Many athletes need more than protection — they need correction. Our in-house lab allows us to create prescription sports glasses and sunglasses tailored to your exact needs. Options include:

  • Single-vision or progressive lenses for clear sight at all distances.
  • Polarized lenses for outdoor sports, cutting glare off water, snow, or asphalt.
  • Anti-fog and scratch-resistant coatings for durability.
  • Prescription goggles for skiing, snowboarding, and swimming.

Sports Sunglasses for Every Activity

From the diamond to the surf, sunglasses built for sports give you an edge in bright conditions. Features like tints, polarization, and wraparound designs can make the difference between a squint and a smooth play. We carry options for:

  • Field sports – Baseball, softball, soccer, and golf.
  • Water sports – Surfing, windsurfing, wakeboarding, kayaking, and jet skiing, with buoyant, fog-resistant designs.
  • Snow sports – Skiing and snowboarding, including glacier goggles for extreme UV reflection at high altitudes.
  • Cycling & running – Lightweight frames that won’t slip during endurance activity.

Personalized Fitting, Local Care

Sports eyewear only works if it fits securely and comfortably. At Optometric Cafe, we take the time to adjust frames, straps, and nose pads so your glasses stay put and perform as hard as you do. We’ll also recommend lens tints or coatings based on your specific sport and environment.

Located in South Beverly Hills, our boutique serves athletes from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. No matter where you’re coming from, you’ll find authentic care and a curated selection just minutes away.

Ready to see your sport differently? Visit Optometric Cafe for a personalized fitting of sports glasses, prescription goggles, and sunglasses. Call (310) 888-2848 to schedule your appointment today.

FAQs: Sports Glasses & Sunglasses

Why are sports glasses better than regular glasses?
They’re made of impact-resistant materials, secure frames, and UV-blocking lenses, while regular glasses may break or shatter during activity.
Can I get prescription sports glasses?
Yes. We craft prescription sports glasses and sunglasses in our in-house lab to match your exact needs.
What coatings are recommended for sports eyewear?
Anti-fog, scratch-resistant, and polarized coatings are common for durability and clear vision.
Do you carry sports eyewear for kids?
Yes. We fit children and teens with safe, durable sports glasses to protect their eyes during games and outdoor play.
What sports benefit most from specialized sunglasses?
Outdoor sports like baseball, skiing, surfing, and cycling benefit from tinted or polarized sports sunglasses that cut glare and enhance clarity.

Related Active Eyewear Guides

Learn more about sports glasses and prescription sunglasses, prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses, and contact lens fittings for active wearers.

Book Your Sports Sunglasses & Eyeglasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Protect your vision and enhance your game with sports sunglasses and eyeglasses designed for impact resistance, comfort, and UV protection. Whether you need prescription sports glasses, wraparound styles, or performance sunglasses, Optometric Cafe will help you find the perfect fit for your sport. Visit our Beverly Hills boutique or call (310) 888-2848 today.

Book Sports Glasses Fitting

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby. We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, The Flats, Holmby Hills, Bel-Air, Benedict Canyon, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Cheviot Hills, South Carthay, and Monte Mar Vista. openGraph.twitter:description: Shop children’s prescription glasses in Beverly Hills with durable frames, comfortable fittings, and patient guidance for growing kids.

content:
Finding great glasses for your child doesn’t have to be stressful. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we make it easy (and fun) with a handpicked collection of durable, comfortable, and stylish frames that kids love to wear. From playful plastics to mini versions of grown-up favorites, every frame on our shelves is chosen with real life in mind—school, play, and everything in between.

Parents tell us they appreciate our family-owned approach and on-site lens lab for quick, precise prescriptions—including complex cases. And kids? They love walking out with glasses that feel good, look cool, and fit their personality. You’ll get honest guidance (never pushy), careful fittings, and lenses crafted right here in Beverly Hills.

Why Beverly Hills Parents Choose Optometric Cafe

  • Bespoke kids’ selection: Frames handpicked by Morteza—from classic tortoise and sleek titanium to bright, playful acetates.
  • Built for real life: Flexible hinges, comfortable bridges, and strong materials that stand up to school and play.
  • Personal frame fitting and lens craftsmanship: Custom lenses made in our own Beverly Hills lab for speed, accuracy, and consistent quality.
  • Complex prescriptions welcome: High powers, astigmatism, prism, progressives—handled with care and experience.
  • Warm, not-pushy fittings: We match frames to face shape, personality, and daily routine so kids actually enjoy wearing them.

Frames Kids Actually Want to Wear

Kids want glasses that look like the people they admire—parents, siblings, friends, or favorite styles they’ve spotted. Our curated assortment makes it easy to find a look that feels “so them,” whether that’s a tiny retro oval, a sporty wrap feel in a durable everyday frame, or a chic, scaled-down cat-eye. Because we’re a boutique (not a big-box wall of sameness), you’ll find unique pieces with better materials and more thoughtful design.

  • Durable plastics: Lightweight, comfy, and available in colors kids love.
  • Flexible, sport-friendly options: Rubberized details and bend-back hinges that help prevent breakage.
  • Titanium: Featherlight, hypoallergenic, and tough—great for sensitive skin or all-day wear.
  • Mini “grown-up” styles: Popular adult looks, scaled to fit small faces beautifully.

Custom Lenses Made in Our On-Site Lab

Your child’s prescription is crafted right here in our Beverly Hills lab—no shipping to a distant warehouse. That means faster turnaround, tighter quality control, and the ability to solve tricky prescriptions that many stores won’t touch. We’ll recommend the right lens design for comfort and clarity now, and we’ll keep measurements on file to make updates simple as your child grows.

  • Impact-resistant materials (polycarbonate/Trivex): Safer for school and sports.
  • Blue-light comfort: Options that help reduce digital eye strain for homework and screens.
  • Anti-reflective and scratch-resistant coatings: Clearer vision, easier cleaning, longer wear.
  • Transitions (light-adaptive): Convenience for sunny playgrounds and after-school activities.
  • Progressives/bifocals (when prescribed): Seamless near-to-far vision for specific needs.

Gentle, Personalized Fittings

Every face is different. Bridge fit, temple length, pantoscopic tilt, and pupillary alignment all matter—especially for children. We adjust frames on the spot and make sure the lenses align precisely with your child’s visual center. Morteza’s calm, friendly approach helps kids relax and enjoy the process; parents appreciate the attention to detail and straightforward guidance.

Style + Protection: Sunglasses for Kids

For outdoor time in Beverly Hills and around Los Angeles, we strongly recommend children’s sunglasses with 100% UV protection. We can craft prescription sunglasses in your child’s favorite style, or add clip-on sun lenses for select frames. For sports, ask us about wrap styles and retention options that stay put in motion.

Made for School, Sports, and Weekends

We’ll help you choose a pair (or two) that fits your child’s week. Many families pick an everyday “school” pair and a second pair for sports or the playground. If your child plays contact or ball sports, we’ll guide you toward safer, impact-resistant options that meet activity demands without sacrificing comfort or style.

Local, Family-Owned, and Here When You Need Us

Optometric Cafe is proudly family-owned in South Beverly Hills, convenient to Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. We keep your child’s measurements and prescription history on file for easy updates, quick fixes, or reorders. If a nose pad needs adjusting or frames need a tune-up after a lively weekend—stop in. We’re happy to help.

Shopping Tips for Parents

  • Let them choose (with guidance): When kids love the look, they wear them more.
  • Prioritize fit first: A comfy bridge and proper frame width matter more than anything.
  • Ask about coatings: AR and scratch-resistance make daily wear easier and clearer.
  • Plan for growth: We can re-adjust as needed and advise on when it’s time to size up or refresh.
  • Consider a second pair: One for school, one for sports, or a dedicated backup for peace of mind.

FAQs: Children’s Prescription Glasses

How fast can you make my child’s lenses?
Because we craft lenses in our on-site lab, most standard prescriptions are ready quickly. Complex prescriptions may take a little longer—we’ll give you a clear timeline during your fitting.
What frame materials are best for active kids?
Durable plastics and flexible, rubberized designs are parent favorites. Titanium is ultra-light and strong for all-day comfort. We’ll match materials to your child’s routine.
Do you handle difficult prescriptions?
Yes. Our lab regularly produces high powers, astigmatism corrections, prism, and progressives for kids when prescribed. We’ll explain options and set expectations clearly.
Should my child get blue-light protection?
For kids on tablets or laptops, blue-light comfort coatings can help reduce digital eye strain. We’ll recommend what makes sense based on age and screen time.
Do you offer prescription sunglasses for kids?
Absolutely. We can craft prescription sunglasses in many children’s frames, or provide clip-on sun lenses for select models.

If your child also needs contact lenses for sports or special occasions, we can help with that, too. Visit our contact lenses page or ask during your fitting.

Helpful Guides for Parents

Parents may also want to read our guides to kids prescription glasses fit and durability, how often children should get eye exams, and screen-related eye strain.

Book Your Child’s Glasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Help your child see clearly and feel confident with children’s prescription glasses crafted in our on-site lab. Call (310) 888-2848 or contact us to arrange a fitting to schedule your visit. We’ll make it easy, friendly, and precise.

Book Children’s Glasses Fitting

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby. We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, The Flats, Holmby Hills, Bel-Air, Benedict Canyon, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Cheviot Hills, South Carthay, and Monte Mar Vista. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.

content:
Men’s eyeglasses have evolved—classic shapes are reborn with modern materials, stronger construction, and cleaner lines. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we curate a bespoke selection of men’s frames handpicked by Morteza, from timeless aviators and double brow-bar designs to minimalist rimless and bold acetate looks.

What makes us different isn’t just selection—it’s the experience. Morteza guides you to frames that suit your face shape, wardrobe, and daily routine, then we craft lenses in our own on-site lab. The process is personal, precise, and never pushy—most clients walk out with glasses they truly love.

Bespoke Frames, Handpicked by Morteza

Our men’s collection balances heritage and innovation. Explore aviator silhouettes, squared classics, double brow-bar statements, and contemporary semi-rimless styles alongside lightweight titanium and refined acetate. Because every frame on our shelves is hand-selected, you’ll find distinctive options you won’t see at run-of-the-mill retailers.

Fit matters as much as style. Frame measurements—lens width, bridge size, and temple length—determine comfort and balance. We fine-tune each choice on your face, ensuring the frame sits naturally, aligns with your pupils, and works seamlessly with your prescription.

Custom Lenses from Our On-Site Lab

Unlike shops that ship orders away, we build your lenses in our Beverly Hills lab for speed, accuracy, and quality control. From single-vision to progressives, anti-fatigue, and high-index designs, every pair is calibrated with meticulous attention to detail. Have a complex or hard-to-make prescription? That’s our specialty—precise optics, comfortable wear, and crystal-clear vision.

Finish your lenses with coatings that fit your lifestyle: anti-reflective for clarity, scratch-resistant for durability, blue-light filtering for screen time, and photochromic options that adapt to sunlight. If you split time between office and outdoors, ask about a second pair or clip-on sun lenses to simplify your day.

Modern Materials, Lasting Comfort

Titanium delivers strength with almost weightless comfort. Stainless steel and aluminum offer sleek profiles and excellent durability. Acetate brings rich color and bold presence—from matte neutrals to layered tortoise. Prefer a clean, minimalist look? Rimless and semi-rimless frames virtually disappear, especially with anti-reflective lenses.

Not sure where to start? Try a spread of silhouettes: squared rectangles to sharpen soft features, round or curved lenses to soften angles, or modern aviators for instant polish. We’ll guide the process until the fit, look, and optics are exactly right.

Precision for Face Shape & Daily Life

Your frame should work with your features and your routine. For smaller faces, we avoid oversized fronts that overwhelm proportions; for broader features, we balance width and bridge to avoid pinching. Morteza’s practical approach aligns your style preferences with real-world comfort—so your new glasses feel natural from day one.

Need task-specific solutions? Explore computer glasses for long screen sessions, sports glasses for active days, and prescription sunglasses for driving and weekends outdoors. We’re happy to help you build a small eyewear wardrobe that fits work, leisure, and travel.

Family Boutique, Not a Chain

We’re a family-owned boutique in South Beverly Hills. That means personal care, continuity, and accountability you can feel. We keep track of your prescriptions over time, adjust frames whenever you need, and make thoughtful recommendations when your lifestyle or vision changes. Many clients visit us annually to refresh lenses and explore new designs—they appreciate a familiar team that knows their preferences and fit.

Our location is convenient to Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Whether you’re updating everyday eyewear or selecting a second pair for specific tasks, we’ll make the process straightforward and enjoyable.

Timeless to Trend-Forward: Current Men’s Frame Directions

  • Worldly: Deep neutrals, subtle metal accents, and squared profiles for a confident, well-traveled look.
  • Dapper: Polished shapes that move from boardroom to evening—think crisp rectangles, slim temples, and refined detailing.
  • Intense: Architectural metal, semi-rimless fronts, and purposeful lines that project focus and intent.

Hard Prescriptions, Easy Experience

If you’ve struggled with progressives, high prescriptions, or astigmatism elsewhere, let us rebuild your confidence. Our careful measurements, lens design choices, and in-house fabrication help minimize distortion and maximize comfort. We’ll tune the frame fit, pantoscopic tilt, and optical center so the lenses perform the way they were designed.

Already wear contacts? We also fit contact lenses and often recommend a complementary pair of glasses for long screen days or evenings when you want to give your eyes a rest.

Compare our guides to choosing prescription glasses, designer eyewear fit, and computer glasses for digital eye strain before your fitting.

Upgrade your vision and your style with men’s prescription glasses crafted in our on-site lab. Call (310) 888-2848 or visit our Beverly Hills boutique to get started.

Book Men’s Glasses Fitting

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby. We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, The Flats, Holmby Hills, Bel-Air, Benedict Canyon, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Cheviot Hills, South Carthay, and Monte Mar Vista. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.

Why UV Protection Matters for Women’s Eyewear

Ultraviolet (UV) rays from the sun can damage delicate structures of the eye, increasing the risk of cataracts, corneal damage, and eyelid skin cancers. While sunglasses are essential outdoors, many prescription eyeglasses can also be enhanced with UV-protective coatings. At Optometric Cafe, we provide lens treatments that block 99–100% of UVA and UVB rays, so your eyes remain safe while your glasses remain stylish and clear.

  • Sassy: Modern, daring styles for women who want their eyewear to make a statement.
  • Urban: Futuristic designs with cutouts, laminated plastics, and architectural details for a sophisticated edge.

Custom Lenses Made in Our Beverly Hills Lab

Unlike many retailers who send prescriptions out to third parties, Optometric Cafe proudly crafts all lenses in our own lab. This means faster turnaround, greater quality control, and the ability to handle specialized or complex prescriptions other shops may decline. From high-index lenses for strong prescriptions to progressives and anti-fatigue lenses, every pair is made with advanced precision technology under our direct supervision.

Family-Owned Care and Expertise

As a family-owned Beverly Hills boutique, Optometric Cafe offers more than eyewear — we provide continuity of care. Morteza’s decades of experience, paired with our commitment to service, create a trusted space where women can confidently explore eyewear options in a supportive, stylish, and friendly environment.

content:
At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, Morteza personally guides frame selection, prescription lens options, and final fitting. Our family-owned optical boutique offers designer frames and hands-on lens craftsmanship for everyday glasses, difficult prescriptions, and frames that need extra attention to fit.

Whether you’re choosing women’s, men’s, or children’s eyeglasses, our team helps you find frames that flatter your features and lenses that protect your vision. We also specialize in computer glasses and sports prescription glasses — tailored for work, play, and family life.

Prescription Glasses for Every Lifestyle

Clear, sharp vision is essential to daily life. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we believe choosing prescription glasses should be as enjoyable as it is precise. As a family-owned boutique, we combine the latest lens technology with personalized care, ensuring every client feels like part of our extended family. From everyday readers to advanced progressives, we make sure your glasses improve not only your vision but also your comfort, confidence, and style.

Unlike chain stores that send orders away, Optometric Cafe has its own in-house optical workshop. This means every pair of lenses is crafted under our direct supervision for accuracy and speed. Whether you need a rush order, advanced coatings, or a difficult prescription, our lab team has the tools and experience to get it right. Our patients appreciate knowing their glasses are not handled by a distant warehouse but right here in Beverly Hills.

Expert Care for Difficult Prescriptions

Some prescriptions are harder to fill than others. High-prescription glasses, progressive designs, or astigmatism corrections require precision to avoid distortion and discomfort. Our specialty is taking on these complex prescriptions and turning them into comfortable, wearable lenses that deliver flawless clarity. Patients who have been turned away by large retailers often come to us for solutions—and leave with glasses that finally work.

Morteza, our owner, brings 40 years of personal experience with frame adjustments and lens fitting. His careful attention ensures that even the most challenging prescriptions are produced with accuracy and aligned perfectly to the wearer’s needs. For many families in Beverly Hills, Morteza has been the trusted guide for years, helping them update prescriptions and select frames season after season.

Women’s, Men’s, and Children’s Eyeglasses

We believe eyewear should be tailored for every member of the family. Our women’s eyeglasses collection highlights both elegance and comfort, with frames that enhance style while accommodating daily use. The men’s eyeglasses line offers classic, modern, and professional looks, balancing durability with refined design. For younger patients, children’s eyeglasses prioritize fit and resilience, ensuring kids can see clearly while studying, playing, or participating in sports.

Because Morteza keeps track of prescriptions for entire families, parents trust him to ensure that children’s vision needs are updated as they grow, while adults can explore new frames with confidence that their lenses will be made exactly to spec. This continuity of care is something chain stores simply cannot offer.

Keeping a Favorite Pair of Frames

If you already have frames you love, ask Morteza to inspect them before replacing the whole pair. Explore replacement lenses for your existing frames and what makes a frame suitable for new lenses.

Frames That Fit Your Face and Personality

Your glasses should feel like they were designed just for you. At Optometric Cafe, frame selection is an art as much as a science. We stock designer frames from trusted brands, carefully chosen for their quality materials and timeless appeal. Whether you prefer rimless sophistication, bold acetate, or lightweight titanium, we’ll guide you toward styles that flatter your features and match your lifestyle.

Morteza personally helps patients try frames, adjust the fit, and refine choices until the perfect match is found. His decades of experience mean he can quickly identify which frames will sit comfortably, highlight your best features, and work seamlessly with your prescription lenses. Patients often describe the experience as transformative—walking in uncertain and walking out with glasses that feel like a natural extension of themselves.

Lenses Designed for Real Life

The lens is the true heart of every pair of glasses. Our lab creates custom lenses designed to match your lifestyle. Whether you need single-vision lenses for reading or driving, progressive glasses fitting for near, intermediate, and distance vision, or computer lenses to ease digital eye strain, we match lens type and coatings to your daily habits. Anti-reflective, blue light protection, and scratch-resistant coatings are also available for long-term comfort.

Because all lenses are made in-house, we can fine-tune every element for maximum precision. Patients with high prescriptions or special needs benefit from our ability to craft custom lenses that many labs cannot produce. That level of detail ensures you’ll enjoy not just better vision but a superior wearing experience every day.

A Beverly Hills Eyeglass Boutique

Located on South Beverly Drive, Optometric Cafe has become a trusted destination for locals from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Our boutique combines the feel of a neighborhood optical shop with the advanced technology of a modern eye care center. Patients often tell us they appreciate the warmth of a family-run business while enjoying services that rival luxury eyewear houses.

We take time to build relationships, not just fill prescriptions. Families return year after year, confident that their eye health and eyewear are in trusted hands. Whether it’s your child’s first pair of glasses, an updated pair of progressives for work, or a stylish new look for weekends, Optometric Cafe makes the experience smooth, personal, and memorable.

Why Choose Optometric Cafe?

  • Family-owned boutique in Beverly Hills with a welcoming, personal touch.
  • In-house optical lab for faster turnaround and unmatched quality control.
  • Expertise in difficult and high-prescription lenses.
  • Curated selection of designer frames for women, men, and children.
  • Decades of hands-on experience from Morteza, our trusted optician.
  • Comprehensive care with continuity for families year after year.

What Happens at Your Glasses Fitting?

  1. Discuss your prescription and daily use. Morteza talks with you about your prescription and how you use your glasses, including reading, screen work, and other everyday activities.
  2. Choose suitable frames and lenses. Explore frames together and discuss which lens options suit your prescription and needs.
  3. Check the fit. Morteza checks the bridge and temples, how the frame sits on your face, and its suitability for your lenses.
  4. Take measurements. Measurements are taken with your chosen frame to guide the positioning of your prescription lenses.
  5. Make final adjustments. When your glasses are ready, Morteza checks the finished fit and makes final adjustments.

Plan Your Glasses Fitting

Bring your current prescription and the glasses you wear now. If you hope to reuse a favorite frame, bring it along so Morteza can assess its condition and suitability for new lenses.

Tell us how you use your glasses: reading, computer work, driving, or moving between different tasks. Point out anything that bothers you about your current pair, such as slipping at the bridge or pressure near your temples, so you can discuss it during your fitting.

Call (310) 888-2848 or contact us about a fitting. Our contact page provides shop details; it does not reserve an appointment. If you need a new prescription, call to confirm optometrist availability.

Schedule your eye exam appointment today with Optometric Cafe. Call us at (310) 888-2848. 

After your eye exam, we can fit you for new contact lenses or prescription glasses. We have our own optometry lab and a great selection of frames.

At Optometric Cafe, eye care is never rushed or impersonal. We’re a family-owned boutique in the heart of Beverly Hills, and every patient who walks through our doors is welcomed like a neighbor. Whether you’re scheduling your child’s first vision check, updating your prescription glasses, or simply making sure your eyes are healthy, we’re here to care for you with the same attention we’d give our own family.

Ophthalmologist by Appointment Only

For medical eye care, our trusted ophthalmologist visits by appointment only. This allows for private, one-on-one time to address conditions like glaucoma, diabetic eye disease, and prescription updates.

Walk-ins are not available for ophthalmology appointments. Please schedule directly with Morteza, who coordinates all bookings and ensures your visit is tailored to your needs.

Caring for Your Vision Over Time

Vision changes can be gradual — sometimes so subtle you hardly notice until they interfere with daily life. That’s why regular eye exams are one of the most important things you can do for your long-term health. During a visit, we look beyond just “reading the chart” to check for early signs of conditions such as glaucoma, cataracts, or macular degeneration, and we help relieve common issues like digital eye strain or allergies.

Many of our patients appreciate that an exam with us also means they can update their look — choosing from prescription glasses, contact lenses, or stylish prescription sunglasses, all fitted with precision and finished in our own optometry lab.

What to Expect at Your Exam

Your visit is thorough but never rushed. We take the time to listen, explain, and answer your questions. A typical eye exam includes:

  • Conversation & History – We start by learning about your health, lifestyle, and vision needs.
  • Visual Acuity Testing – Checking clarity of vision at all distances.
  • Refraction & Prescription – Determining the exact correction for glasses or contacts.
  • Eye Health Screening – Looking for glaucoma, cataracts, retinal conditions, and more.
  • Visual Field Testing – Assessing subtle changes in peripheral vision.
  • Results & Guidance – Morteza personally reviews your results and helps plan the next steps.

Many patients tell us they feel relieved by how comfortable and unrushed the process feels — a refreshing change from larger, corporate-style practices.

Life After the Exam

An eye exam is only the beginning of great vision care. Afterward, we’ll guide you through your options:

  • Prescription Glasses – Hand-picked frames crafted with precision in our lab.
  • Contact Lenses – Comfortable fits from trusted brands like Acuvue, Ciba Vision, and Bausch + Lomb.
  • Prescription Sunglasses – A Beverly Hills essential for driving, beach days, or afternoons outdoors.

Because we finish everything in our own optometry lab, your glasses or lenses are crafted with care and often ready faster than big-box providers.

Who We Care For

Optometric Cafe serves patients across Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Century City, and greater Los Angeles:

  • Children & Teens – Catching vision problems early to support school and sports.
  • Adults – Keeping vision sharp for work, driving, and digital lifestyles.
  • Seniors – Ongoing care for cataracts, glaucoma, and age-related vision changes.
  • Specialty Cases – From complex prescriptions to custom lenses, we help with the tough cases too.

Why Choose Optometric Cafe?

  • A boutique atmosphere in the heart of Beverly Hills.
  • Personal care from Morteza, our licensed family optician.
  • Ophthalmologist available for advanced medical eye exams (by appointment).
  • An on-site optometry lab for faster, more precise results.
  • Exclusive eyewear collections, including luxury prescription sunglasses.
  • Warm, personal service you won’t find at chain stores or online retailers.

Find us at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212.
Call (310) 888-2848 to book your eye exam today.

Planning your visit? Read our guides to what happens during an eye exam, how often to schedule an exam, computer glasses for digital eye strain, and contact lens fittings.

Local Eye Care Guides

Learn more about Beverly Hills eye care for families, eye care near Rodeo Drive, and how often to schedule an eye exam.

Frequently Asked Questions

How often should I have an eye exam?
Most adults benefit from exams every 1–2 years. Children and seniors may need them more often.
Do I need an appointment?
Yes, all exams are by appointment only. Please schedule with Morteza, our licensed optician.
Is the ophthalmologist available for walk-ins?
No, ophthalmology visits are by appointment only.
Can I get prescription sunglasses after my exam?
Yes. We offer a curated selection of frames that can be customized with your prescription.
Do you accept insurance?
We accept many vision plans — call us to confirm your coverage.
What conditions do you check for?
We screen for glaucoma, cataracts, macular degeneration, diabetic eye disease, and more.
How long does the exam take?
Most exams last 30–45 minutes, depending on testing and dilation needs.

Book Your Optometry Appointment in Beverly Hills

Keep your eyes healthy with a comprehensive eye exam at Optometric Cafe. Our experienced optometrist provides personalized care, including vision testing, glaucoma screening, cataract evaluation, and prescription updates. Appointments are required — no walk-ins for optometry services.
Call (310) 888-2848 or schedule your visit today at our Beverly Hills boutique.

Book Optometry Appointment

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby. We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, The Flats, Holmby Hills, Bel-Air, Benedict Canyon, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Cheviot Hills, South Carthay, and Monte Mar Vista. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.

More Than an Eye Exam

After your exam, the right eyewear fit matters. Our Beverly Hills boutique can help with prescription glasses, sunglasses, contact lenses, lens options, and practical frame adjustments.

“Morteza was so helpful, kind and knowledgeable. Great customer service and high quality stuff service here.”

– Davyd G, Google review

openGraph.twitter:description: Explore progressive glasses at Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills. Discover how frame fit, precise measurements, and personal attention shape your next pair.

content:
Reading a message, looking across the room, and checking your computer screen each involve different viewing distances. Progressive glasses bring those distances together in one pair, without a visible bifocal line.

But choosing progressive glasses involves more than selecting a frame you love. The lens design, measurements, and way your glasses sit on your face all deserve attention.

At Optometric Cafe, our family-owned Beverly Hills optical shop, owner Morteza Talebi brings personal care to frame selection, lens fabrication, and fittings. Since 2005, we have helped customers find eyewear that suits both their prescription and everyday life.

What Are Progressive Lenses?

Progressive lenses combine distance, intermediate, and near vision correction through a gradual change in lens power. Different parts of the lens serve different viewing distances, so the placement of those areas matters.

The frame and lens need to work together. Lens manufacturers provide fitting requirements for their designs, including the space needed within the frame. ZEISS’s progressive fitting guidance illustrates why frame selection is part of the fitting process.

Start With a Frame That Fits You

A frame may look appealing on the display and feel quite different after you wear it. When choosing prescription glasses, pay attention to how they rest on your nose, sit around your ears, and stay in place as you move.

For progressives, a stable fit is especially useful: slipping frames change where you look through the lenses.

Bring your current glasses when you visit. Tell us what you like about them and what you would change. Perhaps they slide down, feel heavy, or need frequent adjustment. Those details help guide your next choice.

Why Individual Measurements Matter

Your prescription describes the correction you need. Fitting measurements help position that correction in the frame you choose.

These include where each pupil sits horizontally and vertically within the frame. Depending on the lens design, additional measurements may account for the frame’s angle and its distance from your eyes. ZEISS explains how these individual measurements inform customized lenses.

That is why an in-person fitting deserves time and attention. Your glasses should be considered as a complete pair, with the frame, lenses, and fit working together.

Tell Us How You Use Your Glasses

Do you spend much of your day at a desk? Read for long stretches? Frequently move between close-up tasks and conversations across a room?

Describe your usual activities and working distances when discussing your lenses. For extended screen work, it may also be worth discussing whether a separate pair of computer glasses would suit your needs.

If you have a stronger prescription, frame size and lens choices deserve additional consideration. Our high-prescription glasses guide explores that topic in more detail.

Personal Attention and an In-House Workshop

At Optometric Cafe, Morteza personally helps customers choose and fit their glasses. Our in-house optical workshop allows us to handle lens fabrication, fitting, and adjustments with close attention to the finished pair.

That personal service continues after collection. If your glasses slip or feel uncomfortable, bring them back so we can check the fit. Persistent vision difficulties should also be discussed with your prescribing eye-care professional.

Visit Us for a Progressive-Glasses Fitting

Bring your current prescription and the glasses you wear now. We’ll talk through your preferences, help you explore suitable frames, and discuss the lens options available for your needs.

Visit Optometric Cafe at 277 South Beverly Drive, Beverly Hills, CA 90212, or call (310) 888-2848 to arrange a fitting.

openGraph.og:description: Can your favorite frames take new prescription lenses? Learn what Optometric Cafe checks before lens replacement in its Beverly Hills optical workshop.
openGraph.og:image:alt: Optical craftsperson preparing replacement lenses for an existing eyeglass frame
openGraph.twitter:title: Can You Put New Lenses in Old Frames? Lens Replacement in Beverly Hills | Optometric Cafe
openGraph.twitter:description: Can your favorite frames take new prescription lenses? Learn what Optometric Cafe checks before lens replacement in its Beverly Hills optical workshop.

content:
If you have an eyeglass frame that fits well, carries sentimental value, or is no longer easy to replace, you may not need to give it up when your prescription lenses need to change. Many frames can accept new lenses, but the frame must be inspected carefully before the work is approved.

At Optometric Cafe, Morteza evaluates existing frames and personally oversees lens craftsmanship in the boutique’s in-house optical workshop in Beverly Hills. The goal is to determine whether reusing the frame is practical, safe for the frame, and appropriate for the requested lenses.

Can New Prescription Lenses Go Into an Old Frame?

Often, yes. A well-made frame in sound condition may be a good candidate for replacement lenses. The answer depends on the frame material, construction, age, condition, shape, and the new prescription.

Installing new lenses places some stress on a frame. Older acetate can become brittle, metal rims can weaken or distort, and hinges or screws may already be worn. An inspection is necessary because a frame that looks fine at first glance may not tolerate lens removal and installation reliably.

What Morteza Checks Before Replacing the Lenses

  • Cracks, brittleness, discoloration, or previous repairs
  • Loose hinges, worn screws, stretched rims, and damaged nose pads
  • Whether the bridge and temples still fit correctly
  • The frame’s lens groove, rim, drill mounting, or retaining system
  • Whether the new prescription and lens design suit the frame dimensions
  • Whether replacement parts are available if the frame needs service

Small fit or hardware problems may be addressed before lens work begins. Learn more about eyeglass repair and adjustment in Beverly Hills.

Why Keep an Existing Frame?

Customers choose replacement lenses for many practical and personal reasons:

  • The frame fits exceptionally well
  • The style is discontinued or difficult to replace
  • The frame has sentimental value
  • The customer wants to update clear lenses, progressive lenses, or prescription sunglass lenses
  • A favorite frame can become a useful backup pair

Reusing a frame can be worthwhile, but it is not automatically the lowest-cost or lowest-risk option. The frame’s condition and the complexity of the requested lenses should guide the decision.

When a New Frame May Be the Better Choice

Morteza may recommend a different frame if the existing one is cracked, badly warped, excessively brittle, missing unavailable parts, or poorly suited to the new prescription. A frame may also have become too narrow, too loose, or uncomfortable over time.

For stronger prescriptions, frame size and eye position can affect lens thickness and appearance. Our guide to high-prescription glasses and better frame fit explains why a different frame can sometimes produce a better finished result.

What Types of Replacement Lenses Are Possible?

Depending on the prescription and frame, replacement options may include single-vision lenses, progressive lenses, prescription sunglass lenses, high-index materials, and selected lens treatments or coatings. Not every lens design or material works with every frame.

If you are converting a suitable frame into sunglasses, explore our prescription and designer sunglasses in Beverly Hills. For a completely new pair, visit our prescription eyeglasses page.

How the Lens Replacement Process Works

  1. Bring the frame and prescription. Morteza inspects the frame, discusses how the glasses will be used, and reviews suitable lens options.
  2. Confirm measurements and frame fit. Accurate measurements are taken for the selected lens design and the frame is adjusted as appropriate.
  3. Prepare the lenses. The lens work is coordinated and many details are handled in the on-site workshop.
  4. Install and inspect. The new lenses are fitted into the frame, then checked for alignment, security, and finish.
  5. Complete the final fitting. Morteza adjusts the finished glasses for comfort and stable positioning.

How Long Does Lens Replacement Take?

Timing depends on the prescription, lens material, design, coatings, frame construction, and availability of the required lenses. Some work can move quickly when the necessary materials are available; complex prescriptions or specialty options take longer. Optometric Cafe will provide a realistic expectation after inspecting the frame and prescription.

Can Lenses Be Moved From One Frame to Another?

Usually, lenses are cut for the exact shape and dimensions of one particular frame. Moving finished lenses into a different frame is only possible in limited situations where the new frame is compatible and smaller in the right ways. In most cases, keeping a frame means making new lenses specifically for that frame.

Ask About Replacement Lenses in Beverly Hills

Bring your frame to Optometric Cafe at 277 South Beverly Drive so Morteza can inspect it in person. Please avoid mailing or ordering lenses for an uninspected frame, because photographs cannot reveal every structural problem.

Contact Optometric Cafe or call (310) 888-2848 to ask about replacement lenses for your existing glasses or sunglasses.
